lines.text: Day one. Four lanes of traffic that haven't moved in forty minutes.
Then the radio cuts out mid sentence.
Emergency broadcast, one loop. Stay in your vehicle. Recovery in ten days.
Rule one. Engine off. An idling car is audible at two hundred metres.
Rule two. Hazards off. Light is an address.
Rule three. If someone outside uses your name, do not answer.
Good news. Half a tank, a bottle of water, and a hand crank radio.
Bad news. Your window has been stuck two inches open since August.
Eleven fifty two. A torch starts moving down the line of cars.
It's Marcus. Paramedic. You're bleeding, let me in.
All response units withdrew six hours ago.
